item.title: TSA Scolded Woman For ‘Inappropriate’ Hoodie — She Had Nothing On Underneath
item.description: A woman recently went viral after TSA scolded her at an airport checkpoint for wearing an "inappropriate" hoodie—but the real problem was that she had nothing on underneath. TSA rarely enforces dress codes directly, but bulky clothing like hoodies typically must be removed for security screening, leading to an awkward and confusing encounter.
